intro: San Diego's walk-in and drop-in options are mostly Korean-style: two gender-separated bathhouses a few blocks apart on Convoy Street in Kearny Mesa, and a co-ed heated-room and cold-plunge center in Hillcrest. For a wood-fired sauna, Beach Sauna runs weekend public sessions on South Ponto Beach in Encinitas, about 25 miles north of downtown. Scandinavian Heat Club at Ocean Beach's Barnes Tennis Center was still listed as opening soon on 2026-11-25, and mobile operators such as Go Banya and Roam run occasional pop-up public sessions.

venues.name: Yu Spa
venues.cold_plunge: Cold tubs in the men's and women's sections, plus a shared ice room with jjimjilbang admission
venues.schedule: Mon, Wed, Thu and Sun 9:30am-8:30pm; Fri-Sat 9:30am-9pm; closed Tuesday. Reservations required for admission. Wet areas are gender-separated and clothing-free (no bathing suits); the common area with red clay and Himalayan salt saunas, ice room and rest area is shared and requires the provided uniform. No children under 13; ages 13-17 only with a same-gender parent or guardian.
venues.notes: Sauna admission covers showers, hot and cold tubs, and dry and steam saunas; jjimjilbang admission adds the red clay sauna, Himalayan salt sauna, ice room, common rest area and uniform. Body scrubs and massages include sauna and jjimjilbang admission. Shower before using the tubs. No footwear past the lobby; phones not allowed in locker or wet areas. Sauna temperatures Unknown.

venues.name: Aqua Day Spa
venues.address: 4637 Convoy St, Ste 105, San Diego, CA
venues.session_length: 3-hour limit for spa access (stated with the entry package); single-entry limit Unknown
venues.schedule: Daily 8:30am-9pm. Traditional Korean sauna, completely separated between men and women; bathing suits not allowed. Minors 13-17 must be with a same-gender parent or guardian and have a signed consent form. Reservation requirement for entry Unknown (appointment page is for treatments).
venues.notes: Entrance covers the hot jacuzzi, cold pool, and steam and dry saunas; men's side adds a sleep room, women's side a Himalayan salt and red clay room. Body scrub $85 for 30 minutes (entrance included with treatments). No water on the dry sauna rocks. Phones not allowed in the spa or locker rooms. 4-hour free parking with validation. Sauna temperatures Unknown.

venues.name: Karma Wellness
venues.drop_in_price: $100 adult all-day pass (no re-entry); youth day pass (ages 10-16) $50
venues.session_length: All day per the Wellness Center page (the FAQ describes booking a one-hour session; confirm when booking)
venues.cold_plunge: Cold plunges and a cold room (Wellness Center page lists jacuzzis, cold plunges and steam room as now open; the FAQ still calls them coming soon)
venues.schedule: Wellness Center open daily 10am-9pm, last entry 8pm. Co-ed throughout; provided uniform (shorts and t-shirt) with underwear on; bathing suit for the steam room and cold plunge. Membership not required.
venues.notes: Self-guided circuit of themed rooms: Forest Room, Himalayan Salt Room, Mugwort sauna, Mineral Clay Room, Cold Room and Red Light room, plus jacuzzis, steam room and cold plunges. Heat source and temperatures Unknown. Rooms are social, not silent; phones allowed. Showers and towels provided. On-site parking. Massages and facials sold separately.

venues.name: Beach Sauna
venues.neighborhood: Encinitas (South Ponto Beach, about 25 miles north of downtown San Diego)
venues.drop_in_price: $70 per person public session; $100 VIP package (reserved seating, herbal tea, venik treatment, towel service)
venues.schedule: Public sessions Saturday and Sunday 3pm-10pm only. Book a session online. Private mobile events are also offered.
venues.notes: European-style wood-fired sauna steps from the Pacific with herbal steam. Add-ons: venik (birch and oak bundle) treatment $30, body scrub $30, facial massage $30. Exact parking spot, swimwear rules and capacity Unknown.
